title: Support osxkeychain credential helper - (keys with https:// prefix are rejected)
body:
### Feature request description

- I want podman login on macOS to save credentials in the Keychain, not as base64 in auth.json.
- The documented way is credential-helpers = ["osxkeychain"] in registries.conf.
- docker-credential-osxkeychain always saves keys as https://<host>, even when given a bare hostname.
- Podman rejects those keys, so every pull fails, including public images.

Reproducer (macOS 27.0.1 arm64, Podman 6.1.4 client and server, docker-credential-helper 0.9.12 from Homebrew):
```
$ printf 'credential-helpers = ["osxkeychain"]\n' > /tmp/registries.conf
$ echo '{"ServerURL":"example.test","Username":"u","Secret":"s"}' | docker-credential-osxkeychain store
$ docker-credential-osxkeychain list
{"https://example.test":"u"}
$ CONTAINERS_REGISTRIES_CONF=/tmp/registries.conf podman pull docker.io/library/alpine
Error: key https://example.test contains http[s]:// prefix
```

### Suggest potential solution

- Accept keys from credential helpers that start with https:// or http://, and match them by host, so https://ghcr.io counts as ghcr.io.
- Fallback: if a key can't be used, skip it with a warning instead of failing every pull.

### Have you considered any alternatives?

- Default auth.json: works, but stores credentials as base64.
- Saving keys without the prefix: not possible, because the helper always adds it.
